messages:
Rafael: tiny share — meet Poppy, my new piglet. she immediately used my headphones as a pillow and refused to move. posted: poppy_headphones.jpg
June: 😍 omg she fits right in. does she oink like an alarm or more of a sleepy snort?
Bree: absolutely hiring Poppy as our new Head of Morale. does she take coffee or truffle crumbs? :joy:
Kara: caption contest: 'Poppy: prioritizing naps over standups' 💤🐷
Rafael: vet says piglets are surprisingly tidy if you keep bedding fresh. low-maintenance smell-wise with regular cleaning.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. Livestock (including pigs) require prior sign-off, secure transit, and no free-roaming indoors. Please submit a Pet Visit request at least 72 hours in advance and include an allergy/behavior note.
June: thanks @ops-bot. quick poll — Poppy office cameo when approved? (1) virtual cameo only (2) quick lobby hello in carrier (3) brief desk cameo with mat (react with 1/2/3)
Bree: 2 from me — carrier hello and many treats.
Kara: 1 for now, my keyboard is sacred territory.
Rafael: noted. i will file with People Ops and bring a tiny company bandana if approved. uploaded: poppy_bandana.jpg
Bree: bandana = instant icon. also putting in a request for tiny pig merch.
Kara: petition to make Poppy our official 'mood check' ambassador. thanks for brightening the feed!
Rafael: glad you all like her — will update once People Ops gives the thumbs up 👍
